inventory_method: Exact account URL through Internet Archive CDX; all status-200 HTML rows, preserving repeated timestamps
notes: Each dated row is retained. Raw bytes are stored only when the replay matches its CDX SHA-1 digest.
Twitter/X account names and displayed content are captured evidence, not proof of account ownership at every later date.

fetch.error: ValueError: CDX SHA-1 mismatch: MOHA63QGBPZPJMUXOBHWXQ5IDDJ5MKHE != LHFFLB3RPRWDRQR53IORNIBHX4EAVQXY

pagination_inventory.method: Exact query URL extracted from a checksum-verified profile capture, indexed and fetched via Internet Archive CDX

last_asset_recovery.method: Fetch exact page-linked asset URL at its profile capture date, validate the payload signature and store SHA-256; on replay failure, try the nearest successful exact-URL CDX capture and require its SHA-1 digest.
